cand=[[8]*n for _ in range(n)]

components=[(0,1,9),(2,5,5),(7,10,2)]

    active=[any(v==color for v in []) for a,b,color in components]
    # Input row occupancy by the vertical component intervals
    if r==8:
        active=[True,True,True]
    else:
        active=[(3<=r<=12),(5<=r<=11),(6<=r<=10)]
    k=sum(active)
    for idx,(a,b,color) in enumerate(components):
        if idx>=len(components)-k:
            for c in range(a,b): cand[r][c]=color
# Draw 6 guide on center row and endpoint 7; preserve crossings
for c in range(1,16):
    if cand[8][c]==8: cand[8][c]=6
cand[8][16]=7
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':cand},separators=(',',':')))
